verses.text: Te wach' yik heb' tz'ak'chaj lajwok smul, sukchaj sat schukal heb'.
Te wach' yik heb' syal Jehová to manhxalaj smul heb' t'a yichanh, haton heb' maxtzak k'ub'anel smul t'a heb' yetanimail.
Ayik manto walk'etalaj in mul, yelxo wal ijan ix lajwiel in niwanil ix wab'i, yujto ix in te k'akwi.
Ach in Diosal, k'uhal t'ak'wal yelk'olal ix ak'och in ya'elal. Icha wal anh takinh ank'ultak stakjiel yuj waresma, ichinta ix wab'i.
Ichato chi' ix walank'eta in mul chi' t'ayach, malaj tas ix in k'ub'ejeli. Ix el wal t'a in k'o'ol walan in b'a t'ayach. Ha hachxo Mamin Jehová ix in ak' niwank'olal.
Yuj wal chi' jun, yalokab' sb'a heb' tzach k'anab'ajani yakb'an tzato yala'. Wach'chom sja ya'elal icha ha' eluma', palta max yamchajlaj heb' yuj.
Ha ach ay ach och wenhulok, a ach ol in a kolel t'a ya'elal. Tzach in b'itej yujto ix in a koleli.
Ix yal Jehová t'ayin: Ol ach in k'ayb'ej t'a tas ol a k'ulej. Ol in ch'ox t'ayach b'ajtil ol ach b'atok, ol ach in tanhwej.

Manh utej a b'a icha nok' chej ma icha junok nok' mula, a juntzanh nok' chi' max nachajel-laj yuj nok'. Yowalil syamchajoch wa'an nok' yet' k'e'en freno. Tato manh ichokta tz'utaj nok', max sk'anab'ajejlaj nok', xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ha heb' chuk sb'eyb'al, manh jantakok ya'elal ol kot t'a yib'anh heb'. Haxo heb' ayoch Dios yipok sk'o'ol, a swach'k'olal Dios chi' ol moyank'e heb'.
Hak'ek tzalajb'ok he k'o'ol t'a Jehová ex anima wach' he pensar. B'itananhek t'a tzalajk'olal he masanil ex ayex och t'a stojolal.
